gaps: Raleigh/Durham/Chapel Hill division president: not named in any 2024-2026 public source (company releases since 2023 quote no Raleigh leader; Ryan Wells was area president over Raleigh in Feb 2023).
Nashville division president: not named in any 2024-2026 public source (2025-2026 Nashville releases quote no one; a City Manager, Tim Randolph, was named in 2015 and is not included).
Dallas/Ft. Worth division president: no dated 2025-2026 source. Jeff Katz (undated careers page) and Andy Bott (Dec 2020, division president in training) are kept as Inferred.
Houston sub-division presidents: Greg Grahmann and Ralph Brown were promoted in Feb 2022 and not reconfirmed since.
Regional/area layer outside Texas: no 2025-2026 source names a region or area president for Florida, the Carolinas/Georgia/Tennessee, Midwest or Mountain/West markets.

Division land heads (Director/VP of Land) found only for Indianapolis (Chris Miller), Jacksonville (Aaron O'Reilly, land acquisition manager), Atlanta (Jason Durham) and Austin (Chad Durham, 2023). The other 15 or so divisions' land leads are not publicly named; company-published land-seller phone lines exist for Houston, Austin, Atlanta, Charlotte, Raleigh, Nashville, Indianapolis and Denver/Colorado Springs.
Land development and land entitlement leaders at division level: none publicly named (Indianapolis advertised a land entitlements role in May 2026).

Brands: Encore (55+) and Central Living (in-town) are product lines run inside the divisions, not separate companies; no brand presidents are published. The Build-to-Rent business is led by Chad Durham (2023 source).
Reporting lines are not published; all reporting lines here are inferred from release wording and the COO's remit.
WebSearch allowance ran out during this sweep, so name-finding searches for Raleigh, Nashville and Dallas leaders and for HBA board rosters could not be finished.
